sentences.en: And here's what she had to say.
I was super nervous to kiss Steve Carell.
sentences.zh: 亲吻史蒂夫·卡瑞尔让我超级紧张。

sentences.en: I was so nervous that I was practically going into convulsions.
sentences.zh: 我紧张到几乎要抽搐了。

sentences.en: But I did it, and it was great, and I highly recommend it.
sentences.zh: 但我还是做了，感觉很棒，我强烈推荐。

sentences.en: They're not just going to kiss outside the hotel.
sentences.zh: 他们可不只是在酒店外面亲吻那么简单。

sentences.en: We are going to cut to Michael being sort of shoved out of her.
sentences.zh: 我们要剪辑到迈克尔被从她房间里推出来的画面。
他在走廊里拖着步子走。

sentences.en: And then she's like, wait, you forgot your shoes.
sentences.zh: 然后她就像是，等等，你忘了你的鞋子了。

sentences.en: She just sets them out and quickly shuts the door.
sentences.zh: 她只是把鞋放出来，然后迅速关上了门。

sentences.en: Well, that kind of wraps up Concierge Marie.
sentences.zh: 好吧，礼宾员玛丽的故事就到此为止了。

sentences.en: We had to ask Wendy if she ever gets recognized for being on the show.
sentences.zh: 我们不得不问温迪，她是否因为出演这部剧而被认出来过。

sentences.en: I'm so surprised at that because I was, you know, barely in it.
sentences.zh: 我对此感到非常惊讶，因为你知道，我几乎没怎么出镜。

sentences.en: But, you know, that just speaks to the reach and the popularity of the office.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，这恰恰说明了《办公室》的影响力和受欢迎程度。

sentences.en: I read a fun fact about Wendy.
sentences.zh: 我读到过一个关于温迪的趣事。

sentences.en: Wendy was the editor for California State University's Academic Journal of Social Work.
sentences.zh: 温迪曾是加州州立大学《社会工作学术期刊》的编辑。

sentences.en: This was her day job before she hit it big as an actress.
sentences.zh: 这是她在作为演员成名之前的工作。

sentences.en: But even after she was working all the time, she kept her job until 2012.
sentences.zh: 但即便在工作排得满满当当之后，她还是保留了那份工作直到2012年。

sentences.en: So even after Bridesmaids, she was still editing this journal of social work.
sentences.zh: 所以即使在《伴娘》之后，她依然在编辑这份社会工作期刊。

sentences.en: And we had to ask her about it.
sentences.zh: 我们不得不问问她这件事。

sentences.en: It is true that while I was building my acting career and, you know, doing pretty well, that I kept my side job at Cal State Long Beach.
sentences.zh: 确实，在我发展演艺事业并且做得还不错的时候，我依然保留了在加州州立大学长滩分校的副业。

sentences.en: I was an assistant editor for a social work journal.
sentences.zh: 我当时是一家社会工作期刊的助理编辑。

sentences.en: I did that for 12 years, all through Reno 911, all through, you know, all these movies that I did, Rules of Engagement, and right up until the Goldbergs.
sentences.zh: 我做了12年，贯穿了整个《雷诺911》，贯穿了，你知道的，我拍的所有这些电影，比如《聘妻记》，一直到《戈德堡一家》。

sentences.en: And the only reason I'm not doing it anymore is because the journal folded.
sentences.zh: 我不再做这份工作的唯一原因就是期刊停刊了。

sentences.en: It went out of business, but it was a great job.
sentences.zh: 它倒闭了，但那真的是一份很棒的工作。

sentences.en: It was, like, not even 20 hours a week.
sentences.zh: 每周工作时间甚至不到20个小时。

sentences.en: I could do it from wherever I was.
And it was all about, you know, people in the social work profession.
sentences.zh: 而且内容全是关于，你知道的，社会工作行业的人们。

sentences.en: And let's be honest, those people deserve a lot of credit for what they do.
sentences.zh: 说实话，这些人所做的工作值得我们给予高度赞扬。
他们得到的认可还不够多。

sentences.en: I loved my original boss who used to come and see my shows at the Groundlings.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢我最初的老板，她以前常来看我在Groundlings的演出。

sentences.en: Like, she was just so super supportive that she said, please don't ever quit.
sentences.zh: 她真的非常支持我，甚至跟我说，请千万别辞职。

sentences.en: So I kept my word, and I stayed until the very end.
sentences.zh: 所以我信守承诺，一直坚持到了最后。

sentences.en: See what I was saying about amazing human being?
sentences.zh: 看吧，我说的了不起的人就是这样。

sentences.en: You know, that was so moving to me when I heard it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当我听到这些时，真的非常感动。

sentences.en: My niece is a social worker.
sentences.zh: 我的侄女就是一名社会工作者。

sentences.en: I'm just always, you know, honestly, guys, I'm lifting her up in prayer all the time because it's not an easy job.
sentences.zh: 我总是，你知道的，老实说，伙计们，我一直在为她祈祷，因为那不是一份轻松的工作。

sentences.en: And I'm thankful that we have people that have a passion for helping others in that way.
sentences.zh: 我很感激有这样一群人，他们热衷于以那种方式帮助他人。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's not an easy job because sometimes you have to see and confront real hard things.
sentences.zh: 是的，那确实不容易，因为有时你必须面对和处理非常棘手的事情。

sentences.en: And then you have to hold that.
Well, as if you needed another reason to love Wendy, I would also like to share that in 2009, 2010, and 2011,
sentences.zh: 好吧，如果说你还需要另一个爱温迪的理由，我还想分享的是，在2009年、2010年和2011年，

sentences.en: she rang in the New Year, performing at military bases in Iraq and Kuwait.
sentences.zh: 她是在伊拉克和科威特的军事基地表演中迎接新年的。

sentences.en: And she went to the smaller bases that a lot of people didn't go to that kind of rarely get entertainment.
sentences.zh: 她去了很多很少有人去、几乎没有娱乐活动的偏远小基地。

sentences.en: It was so great to reconnect with you.
sentences.zh: 能和你重新联系上真是太好了。

sentences.en: Thanks for sharing your memories of the office.
sentences.zh: 感谢你分享关于办公室的回忆。

sentences.en: You guys, you can find Wendy in so many places.
sentences.zh: 大家，你们可以在很多地方找到温迪。

sentences.en: She has a podcast called Generation Ripe.

sentences.zh: 那是为40岁以上的“青少年”准备的。

sentences.en: It's described as a Generation Ripe listener is someone who thinks of their age as an asset, not a liability.
sentences.zh: 它的描述是：Generation Ripe的听众是将年龄视为资产而非负担的人。

sentences.en: We are older people with young souls are younger people with old souls.
sentences.zh: 我们是拥有年轻灵魂的老年人，或者是拥有老灵魂的年轻人。

sentences.en: Of course, she's on the Goldbergs.
sentences.zh: 当然，她还在演《戈德堡一家》。

sentences.en: They're about to start season nine.
sentences.zh: 他们马上就要开始第九季了。

sentences.en: She's on a Marvel series on Hulu called Modak and just tons of other things, you guys.
sentences.zh: 她还在Hulu的漫威剧集《魔多客》里出演，还有其他一大堆作品，伙计们。

sentences.en: And you can find her on Instagram at Wendy McClendon Covey.
sentences.zh: 你们可以在Instagram上关注她，账号是Wendy McClendon Covey。

sentences.en: Andy does not remember calling Angela.
sentences.zh: 安迪不记得给安吉拉打过电话。

sentences.en: And he has to go sell paper at Catalyst Paper, which I looked it up.
sentences.zh: 而且他得去Catalyst Paper卖纸，我查过了。

sentences.en: It's a real Canadian paper company, but it looks like its headquarters is based in Richmond, British Columbia, which is over on the West CoaSt.
sentences.zh: 那是一家真正的加拿大造纸公司，但看起来总部在不列颠哥伦比亚省的列治文，那是在西海岸。

sentences.en: I could not find a Winnipeg branch.
I mean, if you couldn't, I doubt it's there.
sentences.zh: 我是说，如果你都找不到，那估计就不存在。

sentences.en: David Wallace calls to congratulate Michael because he did it.
sentences.zh: 大卫·华莱士打电话来祝贺迈克尔，因为他成功了。

sentences.en: Yeah, because he's realized that this trip was a band-aid to try to help his feelings about Holly being transferred.
sentences.zh: 是啊，因为他意识到这次旅行只是为了缓解他对于霍莉被调走而产生的失落感，就像创可贴一样。
于是他把对方臭骂了一顿。
我有一份外景拍摄明细。

sentences.en: Why do you say it like that?
You said it like sad sack.
sentences.zh: 你刚才说得像个丧气鬼一样。
我有一份外景拍摄明细。
好吧，我是在为迈克尔感到难过。

sentences.en: For the Winnipeg Airport for these scenes, we used Terminal No.
sentences.zh: 这些场景里的温尼伯机场，我们用的是洛杉矶国际机场的2号航站楼。

sentences.en: Randy let me know that there was an area that was out of service at that time and that our location manager, Kyle Alexander,
sentences.zh: 兰迪告诉我，当时那里有一个区域处于停用状态，我们的外景经理凯尔·亚历山大，

sentences.en: was able to get an agreement from the LAX airport to let us film there.
sentences.zh: 成功与洛杉矶机场达成协议，让我们在那里拍摄。

sentences.en: Well, LAX does not let you film.
sentences.zh: 是啊，洛杉矶机场通常不让人拍摄。

sentences.en: Well, especially after 9-11, they had incredibly strict airport security.
sentences.zh: 尤其是911之后，他们的机场安保极其严格。

sentences.en: So we were only allowed a very small number of cast and crew and extras.
sentences.zh: 所以我们只被允许带极少数的演职人员和群众演员。

sentences.en: Everybody had to submit credentials very far in advance and had to be screened.
sentences.zh: 每个人都必须提前很久提交证件并接受审查。

sentences.en: So he said they had to create what they called a micro unit.
sentences.zh: 所以他说他们必须组建一个所谓的微型摄制组。

sentences.en: He said that the airplanes outside the window were not Air Canada planes.
sentences.zh: 他说窗外的飞机并不是加拿大航空的飞机。

sentences.en: They had to paint over the logos using visual effects during post-production.
sentences.zh: 他们必须在后期制作中通过视觉特效把标志涂掉。

sentences.en: And so they put the red maple leaf on the tail of one of the planes.
sentences.zh: 于是他们在其中一架飞机的尾部画上了红枫叶。

sentences.en: We could only afford to do one plane.
sentences.zh: 我们只负担得起处理一架飞机。

sentences.en: If you look over Michael's shoulder, it's on the left.
sentences.zh: 如果你看向迈克尔的肩膀那边，它就在左边。

sentences.en: Well, before we get to this big business with Jim and Pam, we should probably let you know that Kelly is going to break up with Daryl.
sentences.zh: 在聊吉姆和帕姆的大事之前，我们得先告诉你们，凯莉要和达里尔分手了。

sentences.en: I mean, Ryan has a text ready to go.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，瑞安已经写好了一条短信。

sentences.en: They just have to hit send together.
sentences.zh: 他们只需要一起按下发送键就行了。

sentences.en: And I think, what does Ryan want?
sentences.zh: 我在想，瑞安到底想要什么？

sentences.en: Does he want Daryl to come upstairs and make a scene?
sentences.zh: 他想让达里尔冲上楼来大闹一场吗？

sentences.en: He wants to be the other guy.
Yeah, he wants a reaction out of Daryl.
sentences.zh: 没错，他想看到达里尔的反应。
达里尔看起来如释重负。

sentences.en: He's whistling as he walks to his car.
sentences.zh: 他吹着口哨走向自己的车。

sentences.en: And then literally is like doing a dance to his pickup truck.
sentences.zh: 然后简直是一路跳着舞走向他的皮卡车。

sentences.en: He's like, whew, thank you, Ryan.
sentences.zh: 他就像在说，呼，谢谢你，瑞安。

sentences.en: And that then, of course, immediately makes Ryan less interested in this relationship.
sentences.zh: 当然，这立刻让瑞安对这段关系没那么感兴趣了。

sentences.en: And again, you guys have this Jim and Pam scene at that golden hour.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，你们在黄金时刻拍了这场吉姆和帕姆的戏。

sentences.en: Your hair is sparkling with sunshine.
sentences.zh: 你的头发在阳光下闪闪发光。

sentences.en: It's like that sunset scene in the parking lot.
sentences.zh: 就像停车场那场日落戏一样。

sentences.en: I thought this scene was really sweet.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这场戏真的很甜。

sentences.en: Pam is standing in the parking lot.
And Jim says, what are you doing here?
sentences.zh: 吉姆问她，你在这里做什么？

sentences.en: Because he had told her on the phone, when you come back, you're going to come back the right way.
sentences.zh: 因为他在电话里告诉过她，等你回来时，你要以正确的方式回来。

sentences.en: If she wants to take the class again, they'll get through it.
sentences.zh: 如果她想重修那门课，他们会一起克服的。

sentences.en: That the right way to come back is for her to come back having graduated from art school.
sentences.zh: 所谓正确的回归方式，就是让她从艺术学校毕业后再回来。

sentences.en: And she says, I'm coming back the wrong way.
sentences.zh: 她说，我是以错误的方式回来的。

sentences.en: She actually hated the graphic design school.
sentences.zh: 她其实很讨厌那所平面设计学校。

sentences.en: She tells Jim, this isn't really what I wanted to do.
sentences.zh: 她告诉吉姆，这并不是我真正想做的事。

sentences.en: But she had to go to find that out.
sentences.zh: 但她必须去尝试才能发现这一点。

sentences.en: You know, we had a question from Evan L.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了埃文·L的一个问题。

sentences.en: Why did the writers have Pam fail art school?
sentences.zh: 为什么编剧要让帕姆在艺术学校挂科？

sentences.en: Well, that's a good question, Evan.
I asked Brent Forrester about it.
sentences.zh: 我问过布伦特·福雷斯特关于这件事的原因。

sentences.en: He said that the story of Pam failing art school and coming back, quote, the wrong way, was a pitch from Jen Salata.
sentences.zh: 他说帕姆艺术学校没毕业就回来，也就是所谓的“走错路”的故事，是简·萨拉塔提出的点子。

sentences.en: Brent said, I have a daughter.
And he said, I'm a big, fat feminiSt.
sentences.zh: 他说，我是个彻头彻尾的女权主义者。

sentences.en: And the idea that Pam would give up on her dreams to be with a man really rubbed him the wrong way.
sentences.zh: 他觉得帕姆为了一个男人放弃梦想的设定让他非常不舒服。

sentences.en: But that Jen Salata absolutely insisted that the romantic power of this gesture outweighed any politics.
sentences.zh: 但简·萨拉塔坚持认为，这种浪漫举动的力量胜过任何政治考量。

sentences.en: And also that the truth for Pam was not that she was giving up on her dreams for Jim, but that she was distinguishing what her real dreams were.
sentences.zh: 而且帕姆的真相并非为了吉姆放弃梦想，而是她认清了自己真正的梦想是什么。

sentences.en: And I really liked that because I think what Pam did here in going to graphic design school was that she was taking her real dream of being a creative artiSt.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢这一点，因为我觉得帕姆去读平面设计学校，其实是在追求她作为创意艺术家的真正梦想。

sentences.en: And she was doing what a lot of artists do, and she was trying to find a practical application.
sentences.zh: 她做了很多艺术家都会做的事，试图寻找一种实际的应用方式。

sentences.en: How can I sort of do art but make a living?
sentences.zh: 我该怎么做艺术又能维持生计呢？

sentences.en: But, you know, I mean, people go into graphic design when they're passionate about graphic design.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，人们从事平面设计是因为他们热爱平面设计。

sentences.en: It's not some backup job, right?
sentences.zh: 那不是什么备选工作，对吧？

sentences.en: And the truth is, is that Pam discovered she does not have a passion for graphic design.
sentences.zh: 事实是，帕姆发现她对平面设计并没有热情。

sentences.en: And that's sort of what I had in my head when I was doing that scene on the phone with Jim and Pam's crying.
sentences.zh: 我在拍那场吉姆和帕姆通电话、帕姆哭泣的戏时，脑子里想的就是这些。

sentences.en: Pam is realizing that even if she did pass the course, this isn't for her.
sentences.zh: 帕姆意识到即使她通过了课程，这也不适合她。

sentences.en: But she's also embarrassed that she failed.
sentences.zh: 但她也为自己的失败感到尴尬。

sentences.en: But what she definitely does not want to do is spend 12 more weeks studying something she doesn't love.
sentences.zh: 但她绝对不想再花12周去学习她不热爱的东西。

sentences.en: For me in that moment, I just saw Pam stating her truth.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，那一刻我只看到帕姆在陈述她的真相。

sentences.en: And I always think that's so powerful.
sentences.zh: 我一直觉得那非常有力量。

sentences.en: There is a very sweet deleted scene, you guys, with Jim and Pam.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，有一个非常温馨的删减片段，是关于吉姆和帕姆的。

sentences.en: Pam is showing Jim her art assignment.
sentences.zh: 帕姆在给吉姆看她的艺术作业。

sentences.en: She has this portfolio, and she's showing him the piece that she got an F on.
sentences.zh: 她拿着文件夹，给吉姆看那份得了F的作品。

sentences.en: Oh, I remember shooting this now.
sentences.zh: 哦，我现在想起来拍过这一段了。

sentences.en: And as he goes through her art assignments, in the back, tucked in the binder, is a sketch pad.
sentences.zh: 当他翻看她的艺术作业时，在文件夹后面夹着一本素描本。

sentences.en: And he's like, what is this?
And she said, oh, you know, it's just sketches of things I would see in New York.
sentences.zh: 她说，哦，你知道，这只是我在纽约看到的一些东西的素描。

sentences.en: And when you look at them, Jenna, and I'll put it in stories, it's like people sitting at a cafe, things she might have seen on her walk.
sentences.zh: 当你看到它们时，珍娜，我会发到故事里，就像人们坐在咖啡馆里，或者是她在散步时看到的东西。

sentences.en: And this is such a wonderful moment.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常美妙的时刻。

sentences.en: I wish it had stayed in.
Sam, can you play the clip?
sentences.zh: 萨姆，能播放一下片段吗？

sentences.en: Before we start, how did you fail?
sentences.zh: 开始之前，你怎么会不及格？

sentences.en: We had to make a logo for a coffee company.
sentences.zh: 我们当时得为一家咖啡公司设计标志。

sentences.en: This is the one that got an A.
I couldn't get it to print out right, so I got an F.
sentences.zh: 我没能把它打印好，所以拿了个F。

sentences.en: I would have given you a D.
That's only because we were sleeping with the professor.
sentences.zh: 那只是因为我们当时和教授有一腿。

sentences.en: It's just, you know, stuff I saw in New York.
sentences.zh: 就是，你知道的，我在纽约看到的一些东西。

sentences.en: It's so much different than your other work.
sentences.zh: 这和你之前的作品很不一样。

sentences.en: Oh, I wish that had stayed in.
sentences.zh: 噢，我真希望那段没被剪掉。

sentences.en: It's a really sweet scene, and I feel like it just shows what Pam did get out of New York,
sentences.zh: 那是一个非常温馨的场景，我觉得它展现了帕姆在纽约到底收获了什么，

sentences.en: and I really wish it had been in the episode.
sentences.zh: 我真的很希望它能出现在正片里。

sentences.en: I agree, because I don't think Pam's art story is over yet.
sentences.zh: 我同意，因为我觉得帕姆的艺术故事还没结束。

sentences.en: You know, she did not have the benefit of, I think, parents or role models who encouraged
sentences.zh: 你知道，她没有那种能鼓励她去追寻自我这一面的父母或榜样，

sentences.en: her to follow this piece of herself, and she only finally does now have that person in Jim.
sentences.zh: 而她现在终于有了吉姆作为那个人。

sentences.en: So she's going to have to take her art journey at the same time as her romantic journey.
sentences.zh: 所以她得同时开启她的艺术之旅和浪漫之旅。

sentences.en: Well, I'm going to put that scene in stories, because it's really sweet.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我会把那个场景放进故事里，因为它真的很温馨。

sentences.en: Well, that kind of wraps up this episode.
sentences.zh: 好了，这集的内容就到这里。

sentences.en: Thank you to everyone who helped us make this episode.
